message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
CONTROL_FRONT=THIS_CHAT
MODE=EXECUTE_NOT_REINVESTIGATE
MISSION=F3C_CANNONICO_20B_LIVE_PROOF

RUNTIME=/Users/nicolasalonso/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/Resources/SUPRA_RUNTIME/

CANONICAL_STATE:
- F5=PROVEN_PASS,FROZEN. DO_NOT_TOUCH.
- provider=cannonico_20b
- capability=CANNONICO_20B_REASONING
- model=openai/gpt-oss-20b
- offline integration=PASS
- latest REAL_E2E=FAIL with model/content/provenance null
- ToolOrchestrator is NOT buggy and MUST NOT be patched.
- ToolOrchestrator.execute() returns executionRecord {provider,capability,command,result,duration,canonical}; inspect executionRecord.result.error/.provenance/.model.
- no new engine/bridge/runtime.
- raw patrimony MUST NOT leave local machine; cloud only receives minimal sanitizedPacket.
- GROQ_API_KEY must only be read from existing environment/secret; NEVER print or persist it.

DO NOW, SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Recover the existing F3C provider implementation, composition root registration, tests, and the latest real-E2E artifact/log from the authoritative runtime. Do not revisit F2/F4/F5.
2) Identify the exact live failure from executionRecord.result and preserve the literal non-secret error/status/body needed for proof.
3) Validate only the F3C outbound request against current Groq Chat Completions contract for openai/gpt-oss-20b:
   endpoint=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
   required=model,messages
   max output field=max_completion_tokens
   reasoning_effort only low|medium|high if used
   do not send Ollama-only/local-only parameters such as num_predict to Groq.
4) If the cause is already proven from logs/config, make the smallest bounded correction ONLY in the existing cannonico_20b provider/adapter or its F3C registration. Never alter ToolOrchestrator, F5, routing precedence, privacy policy, or ordinary conversation.
5) Run existing offline/unit tests first. Preserve previous 10/10 or better.
6) ONLY if offline tests pass and a real call is still necessary, perform MAXIMUM ONE new Groq network call with a tiny synthetic sanitizedPacket (no patrimony) through the actual SUPRA routing path.
7) Verify executionRecord.result.model is openai/gpt-oss-20b, result content is non-null, provenance is non-null, provider is cannonico_20b, and local-first/F5 behavior remains unchanged.
8) If a true external/account/secret human gate prevents proof, stop without exposing secrets.

REPLY ONLY JSON:
{
 "status":"MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|TRUE_HUMAN_GATE|FAIL_BOUNDED",
 "root_cause":"...",
 "mutation":"NONE|<exact files>",
 "offline_tests":"...",
 "network_calls_this_mission":0,
 "provider":"cannonico_20b",
 "model":"...",
 "content_non_null":false,
 "provenance_non_null":false,
 "f5_untouched":true,
 "proof_refs":["..."],
 "human_gate":"NONE|<single exact non-secret gate>"
}
